1	# STM32H7 LVGL DMA2D 50 FPS acceleration
2	
3	## Goal
4	
5	Make VelaGuard scrolling and dragging responsive on STM32H750B-DK by removing
6	the software-rendering and synchronous-page-flip bottlenecks, while preserving
7	the existing 480x272 RGB565 product UI, QSPI XIP, networking, NSH, and touch
8	coordinate correctness.
9	
10	## Background
11	
12	- The prior first-stage task improved scheduling and touch sampling, but user
13	  hardware feedback still reports poor scrolling and low LVGL frame rate.
14	- LTDC currently provides scanout and VSYNC-safe double buffering only. LVGL
15	  has one software draw unit and no DMA2D/GPU/Arm-2D backend.
16	- STM32H7 LTDC source references `CONFIG_STM32H7_DMA2D`, but the H7 DMA2D
17	  driver, Kconfig, register header, and build integration are missing.
18	- `FBIOPAN_DISPLAY` waits synchronously for vertical blank and blocks the UI
19	  thread. The fixed LTDC framebuffer also overlaps the SDRAM heap range.
20	
21	## Requirements
22	
23	- R1: Show LVGL's native FPS/CPU performance monitor at the top-left in every
24	  Debug, Release, and Production build. It must also report render, flush, and
25	  GPU timing; retain an emergency build switch to hide it.
26	- R2: Use `SCHED_CPULOAD_SYSCLK` for CPU load and schedule LVGL display and
27	  input handling every 16 ms.
28	- R3: Reserve the first 1 MiB of SDRAM for LTDC/DMA2D and start the SDRAM heap
29	  at `0xd0100000`; no allocator may own the fixed framebuffer range.
30	- R4: Preserve `/dev/fb0`, RGB565, direct rendering, LTDC double buffering,
31	  and VSYNC-safe flips. Page-flip submission must not block the LVGL thread.
32	- R5: Complete STM32H7 DMA2D support and register an LVGL v9 DMA2D draw unit.
33	  Accelerate supported fill, 1:1 blit, and blend tasks, with software fallback
34	  for unsupported formats/effects and runtime DMA2D errors.
35	- R6: Maintain cache coherency for all DMA read/write areas and never expose a
36	  partially rendered buffer to LTDC.
37	- R7: Use fast polling by default at the validated FT5X06 100 kHz bus rate:
38	  10 ms active and 20 ms idle. Retain interrupt mode as an explicit fallback.
39	- R8: Remove rounded-mask cost from repeated scrolling rows while retaining
40	  rounded static buttons/dialogs and the established industrial visual style.
41	- R9: Carry NuttX and apps/LVGL checkout changes through separate project-owned
42	  idempotent patches. Preserve existing dirty upstream checkout work.
43	- R10: Provide independent build rollback switches for DMA2D, the monitor,
44	  and interrupt touch, and record all selected modes in `build-info.txt`.
45	
46	## Acceptance Criteria
47	
48	- [ ] During a 60-second settings/network scrolling run after 5 seconds of
49	      warm-up, rendered and refreshed FPS stay at or above 50 and frame-time
50	      P95 is at most 20 ms.
51	- [ ] Scrolling CPU usage averages at most 85 percent and never remains at
52	      100 percent for one second; DMA2D builds report non-zero GPU time and
53	      hardware task count.
54	- [ ] DMA2D reference tests match software output for supported RGB565 fills,
55	      blits, alpha blends, clipped areas, and non-trivial strides.
56	- [ ] One hundred presses and thirty long drags contain no lost or stuck
57	      DOWN/MOVE/UP sequence; feedback latency P95 is at most 50 ms.
58	- [ ] No tearing, black frame, FIFO underrun, DMA timeout, cache artifact,
59	      framebuffer/heap overlap, or monotonically growing heap use occurs.
60	- [ ] The same performance run passes while Ethernet/DHCP, acquisition, and
61	      alarm services are active.
62	- [ ] `test/debug`, `test/release`, and `production/release` build and pass the
63	      VelaGuard, settings, QSPI, and new DMA2D static/artifact harnesses.
64	- [ ] `-DisableDma2d`, `-HidePerfMonitor`, and `-InterruptTouch` each produce a
65	      usable rollback image without changing the other two modes.
66	
67	## Out of Scope
68	
69	- A general-purpose GPU framework for non-STM32 targets.
70	- UI workflow redesign or a guaranteed 60 FPS product contract.
71	- Accelerating A8 masks, arbitrary transforms, gradients, or complex vector
72	  paths in the first DMA2D backend.

# VelaGuard Domain

VelaGuard is an independent industrial edge AI gateway context. This glossary fixes the project language used in manuals, plans, firmware modules, cloud services, and UI copy.

## Language

**VelaGuard**:
The STM32H750B-DK based industrial edge gateway that owns local sensor acquisition, local alarm decisions, local UI, and controlled cloud AI interaction.
_Avoid_: AI screen, chat terminal, PC sidecar demo

**Local Safety Loop**:
The offline-capable loop of Modbus acquisition, local rule evaluation, UI alarm display, local logging, and local alarm sound.
_Avoid_: demo loop, fallback-only path

**AI Bridge**:
The cloud service that subscribes to VelaGuard MQTT requests, calls MiMo or related cloud AI services, and publishes structured MQTT responses.
_Avoid_: sidecar, MiMo API, broker

**MQTT Broker**:
The message broker that connects VelaGuard and AI Bridge; it routes topics and enforces client access rules.
_Avoid_: AI Bridge, cloud API

**Device ID**:
The stable identity used in MQTT topics, authentication, logs, and cloud routing for one physical VelaGuard device.
_Avoid_: display name, sensor id

**Display Name**:
A user-facing label for a device or sensor that may change without changing identity or access rights.
_Avoid_: device id

**Sensor Configuration**:
The executable definition of how VelaGuard reads a sensor and evaluates its local alarm rules.
_Avoid_: prompt result, manual notes

**Candidate Configuration**:
A proposed sensor configuration that has not yet passed device-side validation, test read, and local confirmation.
_Avoid_: active config, AI config

**Manual Profile**:
A structured summary of a sensor manual that VelaGuard can use to generate or validate sensor configurations.

1	# Windows VS Code 编译、烧录与调试 STM32H750B-DK
2	
3	## 方案边界
4	
5	STM32H750XBH6 只有 128 KiB 片内 Flash。超过该容量的 openvela 镜像采用：
6	
7	```text
8	0x08000000  片内 Flash：QSPI boot stub
9	0x90000000  外部 QSPI：NuttX/openvela XIP 主镜像
10	```
11	
12	本项目固定以下职责，避免再次把不存在的片内空间声明给 OpenOCD：
13	
14	- WSL：编译 Linux 工具链下的 openvela。
15	- STM32CubeProgrammer：使用
16	  `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` 写入外部 QSPI，再写入片内 boot
17	  stub。
18	- OpenOCD：只作为 Cortex-Debug 的 GDB server，不负责 QSPI 下载。
19	
20	历史提交 `5eb5070` 已在本板验证：xPack OpenOCD 的 `stmqspi` 无法稳定
21	JEDEC probe/write 双 MT25TL01G，而上述 CubeProgrammer External Loader 可以
22	正常擦写和校验。
23	
24	## 1. 环境
25	
26	在 Windows 安装：
27	
28	- VS Code，以及 `ms-vscode-remote.remote-wsl`、`ms-vscode.cpptools`、
29	  `marus25.cortex-debug` 扩展；
30	- WSL，完整 openvela 工作区位于 WSL 文件系统；
31	- STM32CubeCLT/STM32CubeProgrammer；
32	- Windows xPack OpenOCD。
33	
34	开发板通过 ST-LINK USB 连接到 Windows。即使源码和编译环境位于 WSL，
35	CubeProgrammer、OpenOCD 和 ST-LINK 都由 Windows 进程访问，不需要把 USB
36	设备转发给 WSL。
37	
38	源码编辑、自动补全和函数跳转必须在 **Remote - WSL** 窗口中进行。不要把下面
39	的 UNC 路径当作普通 Windows 文件夹长期开发：
40	
41	```text
42	\\wsl.localhost\Debian\home\<user>\openvela\contest2026_004_TeamFalcons
43	```
44	
45	Windows 本地 C/C++ 扩展无法正确跟随 NuttX 的 Linux 绝对符号链接，还会把
46	Windows newlib 与 NuttX libc 混用，表现为 `velaguard_main.c` 没有可靠补全、
47	不能跳转或出现大量错误类型提示。若当前已经打开 UNC 窗口，按
48	`Ctrl+Shift+P` 运行 `Tasks: Run Task`，选择：
49	
50	```text
51	openvela: reopen workspace in WSL for IntelliSense
52	```
53	
54	新窗口左下角必须显示 `WSL: Debian`。首次进入时按扩展面板提示，把
55	`ms-vscode.cpptools` 安装到 WSL；然后运行 `C/C++: Reset IntelliSense
56	Database` 和 `Developer: Reload Window`。项目配置会使用 WSL 内的真实 ARM
57	GCC、NuttX 头文件与 Linux 符号链接。
58	
59	当前硬件任务仍由 Windows 进程访问 CubeProgrammer、OpenOCD 与 ST-LINK。
60	因此编辑/跳转使用 Remote - WSL 窗口；执行现有编译、烧录和 Cortex-Debug
61	任务时保留原 Windows UNC 窗口。不要把 ST-LINK 转发到 WSL，也不要在尚未
62	配置 Windows 工具桥接的 Remote 窗口直接启动 Cortex-Debug。Windows 工具路径
63	位于 `.vscode/settings.json`；安装位置不同时只需修改该文件。
64	
65	PowerShell 脚本也支持环境变量：
66	
67	| 变量 | 用途 |
68	|---|---|
69	| `OPENVELA_WSL_DISTRO` | WSL 发行版，默认 `Debian` |
70	| `OPENVELA_ROOT_WSL` | WSL 中的 openvela 根目录；默认从参赛仓父目录推导 |
71	| `OPENVELA_OUT_DIR` | Windows 产物目录，默认参赛仓 `.debug` |
72	| `STM32_PROGRAMMER_CLI` | `STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe` 完整路径 |
73	| `STM32_EXTERNAL_LOADER` | `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` 完整路径 |
74	
75	## 2. 编译
76	
77	按 `Ctrl+Shift+B`，运行默认测试版本：
78	
79	```text
80	openvela: build VelaGuard test QSPI firmware
81	```
82	
83	构建脚本会：
84	
85	1. 将团队仓内的 QSPI 补丁幂等应用到当前 NuttX checkout；
86	2. 维护 manifest 声明的 VelaGuard 生成态 linkfile；
87	3. 以 `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl` 作为板级驱动基线，但禁用官方
88	   `lvgldemo` 和开发期 VS Code Lab；
89	4. 启用 `CONFIG_STM32H750B_DK_QSPI_BOOT`；
90	5. 启用项目自有 VelaGuard 并将 `velaguard_main` 设置为启动入口；
91	6. 构建主镜像和内部 boot stub；
92	7. 复制以下文件到参赛仓 `.debug`：
93	
94	```text
95	nuttx.elf  nuttx.hex  nuttx.bin
96	qspi_bootstub.elf  qspi_bootstub.hex  qspi_bootstub.bin
97	nuttx.config  build-info.txt
98	```
99	
100	调试构建使用任务 `openvela: build VelaGuard test debug QSPI firmware`，它额外
101	启用 `-g3` 和 `-Og` 调试优化构建。生产身份验证使用
102	`openvela: build VelaGuard production QSPI firmware`。产品模式
103	test/production 与编译模式 debug/release 相互独立。
104	
105	### 增量 vs 全量
106	
107	默认 **incremental**（日常改 app 后 flash 应走这条）：
108	
109	- 已有 `nuttx/.config` 时 **跳过** `configure.sh`；
110	- 仅在 kconfig-tweak 后 `.config` **真的变化** 时才 `make clean`；
111	- 否则直接 `make -j`，只重编改动的目标。
112	
113	需要全量时用 `-Rebuild full` 或任务
114	`openvela: FULL clean+build production QSPI firmware` /
115	`openvela: FULL clean+flash production (CubeProgrammer)`（会重新
116	`configure.sh` 并强制 `make clean`）。
117	
118	```powershell
119	# 默认增量
120	scripts\windows_flash_cube.ps1 -VelaGuardMode production
121	
122	# 强制全量
123	scripts\windows_flash_cube.ps1 -VelaGuardMode production -Rebuild full
124	# 或
125	scripts\windows_build_openvela.ps1 -VelaGuardMode production -FullClean
126	```
127	
128	从 test 切到 production（或改 debug 符号）时，`.config` 会变，**仍会 clean 一次**，属正常。
129	
130	判断编译正确不要只看任务退出码，还应确认 `.debug` 中六个产物都存在，且
131	日志显示主镜像位于 `0x9000xxxx`、boot stub 位于 `0x0800xxxx`。
132	
133	## 3. 下载
134	
135	运行：
136	
137	```text
138	openvela: flash VelaGuard test QSPI firmware (CubeProgrammer)
139	```
140	
141	脚本在连接硬件前检查：
142	
143	- 主 HEX 全部位于 `0x90000000..0x97ffffff`；
144	- boot stub 全部位于 `0x08000000..0x0801ffff`；
145	- CubeProgrammer CLI 与 External Loader 存在。
146	
147	随后依次执行：
148	
149	```text
150	Cube + External Loader → 写入并校验 QSPI 主镜像
151	Cube                   → 写入并校验片内 boot stub
152	Cube                   → 复位
153	```
154	
155	已有产物时可使用 `openvela: flash current artifacts only
156	(CubeProgrammer)`。生产版本使用 `openvela: flash VelaGuard production
157	firmware (CubeProgrammer)`。
158	
159	没有连接开发板时，可在 Windows PowerShell 只验证工具和镜像布局：
160	
161	```powershell
162	scripts\windows_flash_cube.ps1 -NoBuild -ValidateOnly
163	```
164	
165	## 4. 断点调试
166	
167	选择：
168	
169	```text
170	openvela: VelaGuard test debug after Cube flash
171	```
172	
173	按 `F5` 后会先构建并用 CubeProgrammer 下载 debug 镜像，再由 OpenOCD
174	启动 GDB server。配置使用 `request: attach` 和空 `loadFiles`，因此 GDB 只
175	加载 `${workspaceFolder}\.debug\nuttx.elf` 的符号，不会再次写 Flash。
176	
177	若固件已经下载，使用 `openvela: VelaGuard attach only`。
178	
179	推荐的日常操作顺序是：
180	
181	1. 普通运行验证：执行 `openvela: flash VelaGuard test QSPI firmware
182	   (CubeProgrammer)`，它会自动编译、烧录并复位。
183	2. 调试代码：在“运行和调试”中选择 `openvela: VelaGuard test debug
184	   after Cube flash` 后按 `F5`；该配置会先生成并烧录 debug 固件，再 attach。
185	3. 只增加或移动断点、不改固件：选择 `attach only`，避免重复擦写 QSPI。
186	4. 改过代码后不要直接使用 `attach only`，否则板上代码与 ELF 符号可能不一致。
187	
188	连接后若程序正在运行，可先暂停，再在应用源码中下断点并继续。不要用 VS Code
189	或 GDB 的 Download/Load 命令；本项目的 `loadFiles: []` 正是为了阻止这条错误
190	路径。
191	
192	## 5. VelaGuard 运行验证
193	
194	ST-LINK 虚拟串口使用 `115200 8N1`。烧录后，VelaGuard 工业首页会自动显示，
195	不需要运行 openvela 的 `lvgldemo`。界面显示 Device ID、test/production
196	模式、固件版本、存储启动状态，以及 Acquisition、Alarm、Network、Audio、
197	Time 五类状态占位。
198	
199	在 [vg_ui_home.c](../app/velaguard_app/src/vg_ui_home.c) 的
200	`vg_ui_home_uptime_checkpoint()` 中设置断点，按 `F5` attach。每秒 uptime

208	## 6. 故障恢复
209	
210	- `Main QSPI image address range is invalid`：构建未启用 QSPI linker，禁止下载。
